changelog:
v3.7.3 — Smooth 5.1 Audio on Fire TV Stick 4K Max

Fixes repeating buffering on Fire TV Sticks when streams use 5.1 surround audio (EAC3/AC3/DTS, 6 channels).

The hardware AC3/EAC3/DTS decoder on MediaTek Fire TV Sticks (mt8695, mt8696, mt8167) works fine on its own, but the 6-channel → stereo downmix happening after the decoder was too slow to keep up with playback. Audio would starve every 10-15 seconds, the player would stall, our watchdog would try to recover — and the whole thing would loop.

Fix: on the first track selection, if the device is a MediaTek Fire TV Stick AND the stream has 5.1 surround audio, we now preemptively rebuild the player with the FFmpeg-preferred audio pipeline. FFmpeg handles decode + downmix in a single pass and doesn't fall behind.

Affects: live NBA / NFL / sports feeds in 5.1 surround, movies with 5.1 tracks on mt8695/mt8696/mt8167 devices. AAC and 2-channel streams unaffected — they continue using hardware decode as before.
